name: Facet Palm
description: Strike with an open palm faced with a flat sheet of crystal qi so the blow lands in one clean plane.

name: Facet Plate
description: Raise a single flat plate of crystal qi before the chest so that a blow strikes its smooth face.

name: Facet Step
description: Lay a flat crystal tile underfoot and push off its smooth face for a quick even stride.

name: Facet Glint
description: Flick a flat sliver of crystal from the fingertips that glints once and strikes the target.

name: Facet Gaze
description: Hold a clear facet before the eye and read from the light in it where nearby bodies stand.

name: Clear Poise
description: Lay a clear crystal calm on an ally's breath and thought so their aim stops wandering.

name: Quartz Fist
description: Close the fist in a rind of clear quartz and punch so the blow lands with a hard glassy knock.

name: Quartz Shell
description: Grow a thin shell of clear quartz over the forearms to blunt a heavy swing.

name: Quartz Slide
description: Skate forward on a smooth quartz glaze grown under the soles for two quick slides.

name: Quartz Needle
description: Grow a long thin quartz needle in the palm and throw it point first at the target.

name: Quartz Glow
description: Let a bead of quartz glow softly and read from how its light bends where living bodies move.

name: Quartz Brace
description: Grow a slanted quartz wedge on the forearm and turn a thrust off along its slope.

name: Quartz Splint
description: Grow a clear quartz splint round an ally's cracked limb to hold the bone true while it knits.

name: Shard Cut
description: Slash with the edge of a hand tipped with a hard shard of crystal that parts cloth and skin.

name: Shard Scatter
description: Fan a spread of broken shards before the body so that thrown things strike them and glance away.

name: Shard Dart
description: Snap a shard off the wrist and fling it across a short gap into the target's thigh.

name: Shard Skip
description: Drop a shard and leap off its flat side for a quick hop of three paces.

name: Shard Eye
description: Hold a shard to the eye and see through its edge the glint of metal hidden on a stranger.

name: Lattice Jab
description: Jab with a fist whose qi is set in an even lattice so the force runs straight and does not scatter.

name: Lattice Shell
description: Set the qi over the torso in a close lattice that spreads the force of a blow evenly.

name: Lattice Pace
description: Take measured equal paces over a lattice of qi so that every footfall lands where it was set.

name: Lattice Pin
description: Pin the opponent's sleeve or ankle to the ground with a small crystal lattice grown through it.

name: Lattice Cast
description: Cast a small lattice-formed crystal ball that flies straight and breaks into even pieces on the target.

name: Lattice Turn
description: Tilt a lattice plane of qi and let a blow slide off the angle of it.

name: Lattice Feel
description: Feel through a field of lattice qi where a foot has stepped or a hand has moved.

name: Lattice Steady
description: Set an ally's wavering qi into the same even lattice so their strikes fall true again.

name: Prism Palm
description: Strike with a palm holding a small prism of qi that scatters the force into a spread of bright points.

name: Prism Veil
description: Hang a clear prismatic veil before the body that bends a blow off to one side.

name: Prism Skip
description: Hop from one prism of qi to the next in three short springs across the gap.

name: Prism Glare
description: Flash a prism of qi at the opponent's eyes so they flinch and their next move is lost.

name: Prism Sight
description: Peer through a prism of qi to see past a simple disguise or a patch of shadow.

name: Prism Focus
description: Pass a clear prism of qi to an ally so their scattered attention gathers to one bright point.

name: Crystal Knuckle
description: Grow hard crystal over the knuckles in an instant and punch so the blow bites with its edges.

name: Crystal Skin
description: Grow a thin glassy skin of crystal over the exposed arms and neck in one breath.

name: Crystal Hop
description: Grow a knob of crystal under the heel and spring off it for a long hop.

name: Crystal Spike
description: Grow a short crystal spike from the shoulder and loose it forward into the target.

name: Crystal Cuff
description: Grow a ring of crystal round the opponent's wrist so the hand is held fast for a few breaths.

name: Crystal Crack
description: Strike the ground and run a sharp crystal crack under the opponent's feet to spoil their footing.

name: Crystal Seal
description: Grow a thin clear crystal film over an ally's shallow cut to close the wound and stop the blood.
